clauses.why: The name Tekoa is in 2CH 11:6, and 'one of his cities' is not stated; the verses say he built cities for defence in Judah, including Tekoa.
clauses.english: was built by Rehoboam as a city for defence
clauses.ukr: була збудована Рехав'амом як твердинне місто
clauses.deu: wurde von Rehabeam als Festung gebaut
clauses.spa: fue edificada por Roboam para fortificar Judá

clauses.why: The verses say the Tekoites repaired, not that the place sent people; 'two pieces' is the clause's gloss, and a piece beside the nobles' refusal is not needed; keep repairing wall sections, but 'another piece' is the second one.
clauses.english: was repaired by its people in two places along the wall of Jerusalem
clauses.ukr: її жителі направляли дві ділянки муру Єрусалима
clauses.deu: ihre Leute bauten zwei Stücke an der Mauer Jerusalems
clauses.spa: sus habitantes restauraron dos tramos del muro de Jerusalén
